title: Iterative graph lifting for automatic design of path-complete stability certificates
summary: Stability of switched linear systems under arbitrary switching is a fundamental problem in control theory, closely related to the joint spectral radius (JSR), which characterizes the worst-case growth rate of system trajectories. In this paper, we contribute to the path-complete approach for approximating the JSR. This framework constructs algebraic stability certificates using labeled directed graphs, known as path-complete graphs. These certificates can be computed via an associated optimization problem.
